newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arafat and Egypt's Mubarak discuss Mideast peace.
newsitem.headline: Arafat and Egypt's Mubarak discuss Mideast peace.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat and Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak held talks on Wednesday on the problems facing the Middle East peace process.
Officials said Arafat, who arrived in the Egyptian capital on Wednesday, and Mubarak held the talks in Ittihadia palace. The two leaders often consult on the deadlocked peace process.
Arafat said in an interview published in an Israeli daily on Wednesday the Middle East was headed for "the abyss" if Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's policies were not blocked.
Peacemaking halted when Israel on March 18 started building a new 6,500-home Jewish settlement in East Jerusalem, which Israel occupied in 1967 and later annexed.
